answer: Because the pearl count is verified against the harbor text itself, the copper audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 6 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Filling 85 aliases therefore means producing 85 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
